statements.status_notes: Release 1.10.7 holds commit af077f9e, "Initialize the scratch memory store to 0", the 1.10 branch's copy of commit 360f7fa6, which gives pcapint_filter_with_aux_data's scratch memory a value before a filter reads it. OSV's record names no fixed commit, so it matches every commit after the one that brought the flaw.

The commit pinned, nginx's PCRE2 at release 10.49, holds commit ec9c286, "Fix compiler integer overflows" (GHSA-fmgr-6ggq-9859), of OSS-Fuzz's fixed range a2b146a3..e19e76ad. The commits of that range that 10.49 lacks change no code of pcre2_compile: they are release bookkeeping, CI, CMake, pcre2test, pcre2grep, and a fix of pcre2_convert, which nginx does not call. nginx builds only PCRE2's 8-bit library, so pcre2_compile_32 is not built. OSV's range ends at a commit of the main branch that 10.49's release branch does not hold, so it matches 10.49.

statements.impact_statement: The flaw is in the .recover command of SQLite's shell. Dukovo's shell, which the sqlite-cli port builds from this source's shell.c, is compiled with the options of the sqlite port's library, and they leave out SQLITE_ENABLE_DBPAGE_VTAB. The shell has .recover only with that option (SQLITE_SHELL_HAVE_RECOVER, src/shell.c.in), so Dukovo's has none; the lab's SQLite test checks that the shell refuses .recover.

install sets a file's mode before its owner, and leaves the file set-user-ID if changing the owner fails. Radix has no set-user-ID execution: a process keeps its name through exec, and a name is given only when a process is started (ADR 0214, ADR 0219). A file left set-user-ID gives no one any privilege on Dukovo.

statements.impact_statement: The use after free is on the path of xmlXIncludeCopyRange, which copied an XPointer range into the document. libxml2 removed XPointer locations, and that function with them, in commit 669bd349, which release 2.14.0 and every later one hold, so 2.15.4 has no such path. OSV's record names no fixed commit, so it matches every commit after the one that brought the flaw.

statements.status_notes: Commit 36ea881b made xmlOutputBufferCreateFilename close the encoding handler on failure, which htmlSaveFileFormat closed again; commit a530ff12 removed the second close three days later. Every release that holds the first holds the second, so no release has the flaw. In 2.15.4 xmlOutputBufferCreateFilename leaves the handler to its caller on failure (commit fcb7a777), and htmlSaveFileFormat closes it once. OSV's record names no fixed commit, so it matches every commit after the one that brought the flaw.
